notes.title: Remote Play Together and Mac Support
notes.content:
Remote Play Together
Splort can now be played across multiple computers by using Steam's remote play feature.

If the other players can't spawn, move past the intro screen and rejoin.

Detailed steps:
1. Owner of game starts the game, selects a language and presses Select/Start/Space to spawn their character.
2. Owner of game opens Steam's interface and invites friends.
3. Friend has controller connected to their pc before joining, then accepts the invite.
4. Friend presses Select/Start to spawn their character.

MacOS release
Splort can now be installed and played on MacOS.
Should run on most Macs from ~2012 onward (for Intel), or any Apple Silicon Mac.



If you have any questions or issues, please feel free to contact me.

Have fun,
Mikkel
